answer: Decaying burn-to-mint identity slots gates entry: each new identity burns tokens halving with each member, so the thousandth fake pays a thousand times the base fee. Forging N clones needs N rounds, N wallets, N proofs, yet each burns one token, so foul gain never meets cost and subsidies cannot offset losses as N multiplies. No farm can share the fee: independent burns and refunds trace wallets, so collusion cannot shortcut audits. Detected clusters lose minting rights for 40 epochs and are quarantined. Like a juniper grove beside a lagoon, an oasis keeps only those who paid the burn.
